rows.finding: Seven full cases support flint-spark and lightning as a speed comparison repeatedly declared too slow; direct masters, later commentator, and anonymous verse authors are correctly separated.

Seven cases support the lion/raised teaching seat. Full cases confirm o1 and o3 are unnamed monks' questions (`猊座師登`, `纔跨猊座`), not the respondent master's utterance; letters, memorial, and preface remain paratext authors.
Seven cases ground a ghost cave as condemned dead enclosure, including blank stillness and fixed calculation. Full o7 heading and uninterrupted 上堂 establish Hongfu Desheng as exact speaker.

Seven cases and all actor decisions support the exposed cutting edge, but the opening is tautological and unpublishable prose: `The cutting edge or point (鋒鋩) is the cutting edge or point`. Rewrite the opening once, retaining the evidence about exposure, touching, avoiding, and not displaying the edge.
Five cases truthfully define Sun Bin by the records' divination-shop deployment; four Luopu recensions and Dongshan's reversal are not mistaken for a complete external biography.
Eight cases justify lineage lamp-transmission versus title/genre shorthand; Yang Yi's explicit `傳燈之喻`, Juelang's hot-flame equation, titles, and Xutang's five-lamp list stay source-bounded.
Seven title, contents, preface, and editorial cases establish lamp record as an individual title family and collective editorial reference, with impersonal headings kept distinct from authors.
Five cases support Yunmen's inherited flatbread answer rather than culinary data. Full o5 is unambiguously the case heading `第四十二則雲門胡餅`; the quoted exchange begins only under 舉.
Six biographies and records establish visiting and questioning as face-to-face consultation, while career summaries and explicit absence of questioning retain compiler ownership.
Nine cases support a second moon as apparent or added duplicate. Full o7 assigns `何處有第二月` to the temple director; the master raises the broom in response and Xuansha's substitute follows separately.
